sentence: We present the case of an 11-year-old male from Gambia who presented with macroscopic hematuria predominantly at the end of urination and dysuria of one year's duration; no history of fever.
When taking the anamnesis, they refer to a recent trip to his country of origin and during the trip, several swims in lakes in the region.

Given the clinical suspicion of bilharzhiasis, the Microbiology Service of the reference hospital is contacted, where they indicate collection of urine for three consecutive days, preferably at midday and at the end of urination (the time when egg excretion is maximum) and A study by renovesical ultrasound is requested.
The microbiological study showed Schistosoma haematobium eggs.

The bladder ultrasound performed revealed wall thickening that reached a maximum thickness of 9 mm in a radius of 20 mm, suggesting schistosomiasis, for which treatment with praziquantel was prescribed.
